title: Filter by a range of departure dates
prompt: Add a filter so users can see only voyages departing between two dates. Dates before today cannot be chosen.

mustNot.why: Use DateRangePicker, not native date inputs

requires.why: Past dates are disabled with minDate
The fixed aria-label hides the label; name both inputs with aria-labelledby (date-range-picker.md)
Say the allowed range in helperText (Figma)

rubric: The value is handled as [start, end] from onChange.
The label names the period ("Departure between").
